# INSPECT: find the existing repeating INDEX/MOD/COUNTA formula and derive its source range.
source_range = None

    for cell in row:
        val = cell.value
        text = getattr(val, "text", val)
        if isinstance(text, str) and "INDEX(" in text.upper() and "COUNTA(" in text.upper():
            m = re.search(r'INDEX\(\s*(\$?[A-Z]+\$?\d+\s*:\s*\$?[A-Z]+\$?\d+)', text, flags=re.I)
            if m:
                source_range = m.group(1).replace(" ", "")

    if source_range:

    else:

ans_col_letters = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)", answer_cell).group(1)

formula = f'=INDEX({source_range},MOD(COLUMNS(${ans_col_letters}:{ans_col_letters})-1,COUNTIF({source_range},"?*"))+1)'
